title: Mediocre product
text:
I found this to be mediocre at best. I continued this membership for three months, hoping that my initial medium to poor products would improve. In my first monthly two packets, one was ok and the other was poor quality broken up bits of jerky. The second monthly pack contained another one that was ok and the second pack was really not to my taste (tasted gross IMHO). The third pack contained a pack of jerky that was no better than anything I would get at a store or grocery chain, but the selling point was that it "supported the troops". I'm all for supporting the troops, but when I've signed up for a premium jerky subscription, I expect it to be premium in quality and taste, not marketing value.

All in all, I didn't feel that they really were delivering a premium product.
label: neutral
